title: Documents
subtitle: Employee and candidate documents, verification, expiry and required documents.
ownSubtitle: Your documents and your required-document checklist.

storage.notice: Demo: files are not uploaded or stored. Only the document details and the file names are kept, in this browser tab, until reload. Storing and downloading real files requires the secure backend.
storage.short: Demo: file contents are not stored and cannot be downloaded.

history.registered: Registered from a leave request by {{by}}
history.replaces: Uploaded by {{by}} as a replacement of
history.linked-to-employee: Linked to the new employee by {{by}} (candidate hired)
history.returned-to-review: Returned to review after changes by {{by}}

kpis.label: Document key figures
kpis.totalHint: Every document you may see, including archived and superseded ones.
kpis.expiredHint: Current documents past their expiry date.

expiry.title: Document expiry
expiry.subtitle: Current documents expiring per month, next 12 months

overview.empty: There are no documents to show yet.

directory.title: Documents
directory.search: Search by document, number, employee or employee number

upload.title: Upload document (simulated)
upload.simulatedNotice: Simulated upload: the files are only checked and described (name, size, type). Their content is not sent or stored, and they cannot be downloaded later.
upload.replaceHint: The current document is kept and linked. It becomes superseded only when this replacement is verified.
upload.chooseCategoryFirst: Choose a category to see the allowed file types and size.
upload.allowed: Allowed: {{types}} · up to {{size}} MB each · at most {{max}} files

details.notFound: This document does not exist or is not available to you.
details.notesHint: Visible to HR only — never to the employee.
details.expiredPending: This document has expired: it cannot be verified. Request or upload a replacement.
details.expiredNote: Expired: this document is not treated as valid, whatever its review decision.
details.linkedAfterHire: Shown on the employee's record since the candidate was hired (same record, not a copy).
details.replacementUploaded: The replacement was uploaded (simulated) and is pending review.

edit.title: Edit document details
edit.reviewHint: Changing the category, number or dates returns a verified document to review.

verify.title: Verify “{{name}}”?
verify.text: Confirm that the document was checked and is valid. The decision is recorded with your name and the date.
verify.replacesText: Verifying this replacement supersedes {{reference}} (kept in the history, never deleted).

reject.title: Reject “{{name}}”
reject.hint: Explain why. The reason is recorded and shown to the owner, who must provide a replacement.

replacement.title: Request a replacement
replacement.hint: Explain what is needed. No e-mail or notification is sent in the demo.

archive.title: Archive “{{name}}”
archive.hint: Archived documents are kept as history but no longer count as current. Give a reason.

note.title: Add an internal note
note.hint: Internal notes are visible to HR only, never to the employee.

expiry.title: Expiring documents
expiry.hint: Current documents with an expiry date. “Expiring soon” uses a {{days}}-day warning threshold.
expiry.noReminders: No e-mails or push notifications are sent in the demo.

categories.title: Document categories
categories.hint: Categories decide allowed files, expiry and number rules, confidentiality and who can see documents.
categories.readOnly: Categories are configured by the HR Administrator.
categories.editHint: Existing documents keep their details; the new rules apply to uploads and edits.
categories.groupHint: The group also decides access: payroll roles see Payroll, recruiters Recruitment.
categories.flagManager: Visible to department managers (standard confidentiality only)
categories.flagTransfer: Candidate documents follow the candidate when hired
categories.deactivateText: No new documents can use it; existing documents keep it. Categories required by an active rule cannot be deactivated.

required.hint: Required documents are information only: missing documents never block payroll or change an employee's status.
required.rulesHint: Any one of a rule's categories satisfies it.
required.anyOf: Satisfied by any of these categories
required.thresholdHint: Documents expiring within this many days are “expiring soon” (1–180, initially 30).
required.thresholdSaved: The expiry warning threshold was saved.
required.noBlocking: No policy is configured to block payroll or change employment status because of missing documents.

compliance.title: Employee compliance
compliance.subtitle: Active employees in your scope; select a name to see the checklist.
compliance.subtitleOne: Missing and expired are different: an expired document exists and must be renewed.

employeeTab.subtitle: From Documents Management — only the documents you may see.
employeeTab.payslipsHint: References to the payslips issued by Payroll (opened in Payroll).

candidateTab.title: Candidate documents
candidateTab.subtitle: Visible to recruitment users only. Identity and education documents follow the candidate when hired.

payrollPanel.title: Payroll supporting documents
payrollPanel.subtitle: Salary-related documents from Documents Management (payroll categories only).

my.subtitle: Your documents on record.
my.none: You have no documents on record.
my.noEmployeeRecord: No employee record is linked to this account.
my.privacy: You see your own documents only. Internal HR notes and restricted documents are never sent to your browser.

validation.invalidCode: Use capital letters, digits and hyphens (up to 24).
validation.invalidSize: Enter a whole number from 1 to 25.
validation.invalidThreshold: Enter a whole number from 1 to 180.
validation.fileType: This file type is not allowed for the category.
validation.fileSize: The file is larger than the category allows.
validation.expiryRequired: This category requires an expiry date.
validation.numberRequired: This category requires a document number.
validation.issueInFuture: The issue date cannot be in the future.
validation.expiryBeforeIssue: The expiry date cannot precede the issue date.

serverErrors.stateChanged: This record changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.
serverErrors.duplicateNumber: Another current document of this category has this number.
serverErrors.notForOwner: This category does not apply to this owner.
serverErrors.notEligible: This category does not apply to the employee's employment type.
serverErrors.ownerInactive: The owner is inactive: no new documents.
serverErrors.notEditable: Archived and superseded documents cannot be edited.
serverErrors.alreadyHistorical: The document is already archived or superseded.
serverErrors.historicalCannotVerify: Archived and superseded documents cannot be verified.
serverErrors.notPending: Only documents pending review can be verified or rejected.
serverErrors.expiredCannotVerify: An expired document cannot be verified.
serverErrors.cannotRequestReplacement: A replacement cannot be requested for this document now.
serverErrors.cannotReplace: This document cannot be replaced (already replaced or historical).
serverErrors.categoryRequired: An active required-document rule uses this category.
serverErrors.ownerTypeInUse: Documents of this owner type already use the category.
